name: corecog-derived
quarantine_reason: Direction is not identified. The counts come from unordered pairs of two daughter varieties; which state is historically earlier cannot be read off such a pair at all.

The pair orientation is not what the old caveat claimed. It said 'alphabetically-first variety', but the deriving script iterates varieties in input encounter order and never sorts, so re-ordering the input rows flips the labels.

The cost transform is inverted. derive_direction_costs.py documents that the more frequent direction should be discounted below 1.0, then computes pos_to_neg = 2.0 * (pos_to_neg / total), which grows with frequency.
Cognate sets contribute quadratically (all language pairs within a set), so large sets and densely sampled families dominate, with no family weighting or effective-sample-size reporting.
Environment is pooled away, though sound change is typically conditioned by neighbouring segments, syllable position, stress, and morphology.
The alignments were produced with the same dissimilarity these numbers were then meant to calibrate, so the procedure is partly circular.
superseded_by: Nothing yet. A replacement needs directed ancestor-descendant observations (family, branch, ancestor_state, descendant_state, contexts, ordering, cognate_set, source, confidence) with family-level holdout.
source: Derived from 149344 cognate pairs across 56 CoreCog datasets
